q1.a: B4K is a K-culture travel discovery platform for foreign tourists visiting Korea. Find K-Pop venues, K-Drama filming locations, beauty spots, and more — then build your own itinerary.

q2.q: Do I need an account to use B4K?
q2.a: You can explore the map without an account. Saving places, creating itineraries, and joining the leaderboard require signing in with Google.

q3.a: B4K is available in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Thai, and Portuguese (Brazil).

q1.q: How do I save a place?
q1.a: Tap any pin on the map to open the place panel, then tap the bookmark icon to save it. Saved places appear in your Saved tab.

q2.q: How do I build an itinerary?
q2.a: Open a place on the map and tap 'Add to plan' in the panel. You can add multiple stops, reorder them, and let B4K calculate the best route.

q1.q: How do I change my profile?
q1.a: Go to your profile (the icon at the bottom of the sidebar), then tap the edit icon to update your display name and language preference.

q2.q: How do I delete my account?
q2.a: In Profile → Settings, tap 'Delete account'. Your data is held for 30 days before permanent deletion, in line with Korean privacy law (PIPA).

q3.q: How do I change my password?
q3.a: If you signed up with email, go to Profile → Settings to update your password. If you signed in with Google, Apple, or Microsoft, manage your password with that provider — B4K does not store it.

q1.a: B4K is a K-culture travel discovery platform for foreign tourists visiting Korea. Explore K-Pop venues, K-Drama filming locations, K-Beauty spots, and K-Culture landmarks on an interactive map, then build your own trip plan.

q2.q: How do I create an account?
q2.a: Sign up with your email and a password, or continue with Google, Apple, or Microsoft. There is no separate onboarding — once you sign up you land straight on the Home page.

q3.a: B4K is available in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Thai, and Brazilian Portuguese. You can change your language anytime in Profile settings.

q1.q: How do I create a trip plan?
q1.a: Open a place on the map and add it to your plan. Add stops, reorder them, and each leg shows an estimated travel time. When you are happy with it, tap Save Plan. You can also ask the AI assistant to draft a plan for you.

q2.q: Can I use B4K without an account?
q2.a: Yes. You can explore the map and build a plan as a guest — your draft is kept in your browser so it survives a refresh. You only need to sign in when you tap Save Plan, and your draft moves to your account automatically.

q3.q: Is there a limit on how many stops a plan can have?
q3.a: A single plan can hold up to 40 stops. Once you reach the limit the Add button is disabled and a message lets you know. There is no in-app payment — partner plans simply link out to the partner's website.

q1.q: How do I save a place?
q1.a: Open any place from the map and tap the bookmark icon. Saved places appear in your Saved tab, where you can browse them all in one list.

q2.a: Folders let you organize your saved places into single-level groups — for example one folder per city or per interest. Folders are for saved places only; saved plans stay in a single flat list.

q3.q: How do I generate a plan from saved places?
q3.a: In the Saved tab, select the places you want with the checkboxes, then choose Generate plan. B4K arranges them into a suggested route and opens the new plan so you can fine-tune it.

q1.a: First try refreshing the page. If the map still doesn't appear, check your internet connection and disable any ad or script blockers, which can interfere with the map. If the problem continues, contact us using the email below.

q2.q: The app is in the wrong language.
q2.a: B4K picks a language from your browser settings and falls back to English if your language isn't supported. To set it yourself, open Profile → Settings and choose your preferred language.

q3.q: How do I report a problem?
q3.a: Use the email address in the Contact section below to report bugs or send feedback. Please include what you were doing, your device, and your browser so we can help faster.
